It was precisely during this Asian tour last year when the Murcian won 6-4 6-3. If Carlos is fully focused and maintains tactical order, as well as a good service level, he should have no problems defeating the Belgian, whose season has been heavily marked by agonizing losses in Grand Slam tournaments.Indeed, both at Wimbledon (in five sets against Fery) and at the US Open (in five sets against Botic), he suffered losses that sting forever, being aware that he was presented with great opportunities to explore his limits and accomplish something significant.
